study: Stanford ECoG library, fingerflex development-only cross-person source
selection_basis: Prior participant-split development roster in lexical release order. All other people are closed.
crop: For each recording with N 1000-Hz voltage samples, use only indices [0, 40 * floor((3 * N) / 200) - 4000). The crop is fixed administratively. Exclude any target or input that needs a sample beyond this interval.
before_method_freeze: Directory, static regional/contact metadata, original notes, cue chronology/phase and calibration logistics only. No new neural or glove outcome inspection.
prior_experiment: All later bp windows remain closed to this experiment.
data_access: Only four new selected fingerflex ZIP members may be acquired. Reuse existing bp provenance and development crop. No original recording, subject geometry, raw coordinates or private launch context in public products.
